encoding: byte b decodes as lo + b/255*(hi-lo) unless a channel says otherwise

channels.name: water
channels.unit: expected % of the cell under water that month
channels.source: JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyRecurrence x water share of the cell

nodata.meaning: no data: land, or no valid ocean value that month (sea ice, persistent cloud, coast)

channels.name: current_u
channels.source: HYCOM/sea_water_velocity velocity_u_0 x 0.001, daily 00 UTC fields, 2015-2024 (to 2024-09) monthly mean
channels.encoding: 0 = no data; b in 1..255 decodes as lo + (b-1)/254*(hi-lo)

channels.name: current_v
channels.source: HYCOM/sea_water_velocity velocity_v_0 x 0.001, daily 00 UTC fields, 2015-2024 (to 2024-09) monthly mean
channels.encoding: 0 = no data; b in 1..255 decodes as lo + (b-1)/254*(hi-lo)

channels.name: chlorophyll
channels.source: NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI chlor_a, 2015-2024 monthly mean, then log10
channels.encoding: 0 = no data; b in 1..255 decodes as lo + (b-1)/254*(hi-lo)

channels.name: class
channels.source: ESA/WorldCover/v200 Map, majority of ~1 km mode cells per pixel; sea = WorldCover no-data or water that HYCOM treats as ocean; beyond WorldCover (south of 60S, north of 82.75N) snow/ice where NOAA/NGDC/ETOPO1 ice_surface - bedrock >= 10 m, else 0

channels.name: tree
channels.unit: % of the cell's land under tree canopy

channels.name: hillshade
channels.unit: shaded relief brightness, 181 = flat (sun azimuth 315°, altitude 45°)
channels.source: NOAA/NGDC/ETOPO1 ice_surface, ee.Terrain.hillshade at the 4096 grid, 8x vertical exaggeration; sea floor included

channels.name: elevation
channels.unit: m above sea level (sea floor negative, top of ice sheets)

channels.name: lights
channels.source: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/ANNUAL_V22 average_masked (background and fires removed), 2022-2024 mean
